title: Praxis Health - Redwood Onboarding Kickoff
header: Date: 2026-10-08 | Time: 14:00 PT | Duration: ~45m | Attendees: Leah, Carlos, Priya (Redwood); Anika, Marcus, Samir, Olivia (Praxis)
summary: Kickoff for Praxis Health onboarding to Redwood. Covered high-level timeline, sandbox setup, SSO / SAML, VPC options, pilot scope (chat triage + clinical summarization), success metrics (latency < 300ms p50, cost targets), and next steps: send SSO docs, provision sandbox, schedule SE deep dive and benchmark run. Customer raised questions about PHI handling, KMS, audit logs, and dedicated capacity pricing.
topics: Deployment options: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC
action_items: Priya Shah (Redwood): Send onboarding guide + SSO/SAML doc by 2026-10-11
Carlos Nguyen (Redwood): Provision sandbox cluster and share access (creds/notes) by 2026-10-12
Samir Patel (Praxis): Share sample de-identified traffic and API spec by 2026-10-14
Leah Martinez (Redwood): Send initial pricing outline for Dedicated + pilot by 2026-10-13
next_steps: Redwood to provision sandbox and share next week
Schedule technical deep dive for infra team (Carlos + Samir) - TBD 60-90 min
Praxis to assemble stakeholders and confirm pilot success metric owners
Exchange SSO metadata and start SAML test
transcript:
[00:00] Leah Martinez: Hey everyone thanks for joining, I'm Leah from Redwood. with me is Carlos our solutions engineer and Priya our CSM. um we scheduled 45 minutes to run through the onboarding plan, hear Praxis's priorities and set next steps.
[00:12] Dr. Anika Rao: Hi Leah, thanks. Anika here, CTO at Praxis. excited to get started. we are really focused on clinical summarization and chat triage workflows, and we need to make sure PHI handling is solid.
[00:28] Marcus Lee: Marcus - VP Eng. I'll be owning the delivery side.
[00:32] Samir Patel: Samir, DevOps. concerned about network and key management, VPC peering details.
[00:36] Olivia Chen: Olivia, PM for the triage product. hi all.
[00:40] Carlos Nguyen: Awesome. quick high level - onboarding generally has three phases: sandbox & pilot, validation/benchmarks, then production roll. For pilot we recommend starting with a small traffic pattern (chat triage + summarization) so we can tune batching and caching.
[01:05] Anika: timeline wise how quickly can we have a sandbox? we have a compliance review coming up mid-November.
[01:12] Priya Shah: we can provision a sandbox in about 3-5 business days, depending on SSO and creds. Priya (CSM) will coordinate the kickoff tasks.
[01:22] Leah: noted, we want to align on success criteria today: what does Praxis consider a successful pilot?
[01:28] Olivia: primarily latency under 300ms p50 for triage responses, and summaries with > 90% clinical accuracy on our eval set, also costs shouldn't exceed X per 1k sessions - we'll send exact baseline.
[01:40] Marcus: also need audit logs, per-request tracing, retention policies.
[01:45] Carlos: yes we have token-level cost breakdowns and per-route dashboards in the console; audit logs and request tracing available, we integrate with your ELK stack or send logs to S3. small note - some product names in our docs occasionally show as Redwood Dedicted in older slides, that's a doc typo.
[02:05] Samir: on encryption - customer-managed keys? we are using AWS KMS and want HSM-backed keys for the production cluster.
[02:13] Carlos: supported — KMS/HSM integrations are available for Private and Dedicated; hosted has envelope encryption, but for full CMK control we'd recommend Dedicated or Private with the KMS integration.
[02:26] Anika: data residency - can we ensure tokens and logs stay in us-east-1?
[02:30] Leah: yes, we can pin regions for Dedicated or Private. hosted tier has region options but Dedicated gives stronger guarantees. we'll put that in the pricing email.
[02:41] Olivia: what is the difference in throughput between hosted and Dedicated?
[02:45] Carlos: Hosted is multi-tenant optimized for scale; Dedicated gives you reserved GPU pools and predictable throughput with autoscaling policies. in practice cors we see 2-3x better p50 latencies for small-seq workloads on Dedicated due to reduced noisy neighbor effects. but it's a cost tradeoff.
[03:05] Marcus: can we do a short benchmark run in the sandbox that mimics our traffic distribution?
[03:09] Carlos: absolutely - we'll run a benchmark harness. send sample payloads and sequence length dist and we'll simulate. small caveat: in sandbox the scheduling may not mirror production Dedicated exactly but we can calibrate.
[03:25] Leah: security items - SSO/SAML, RBAC, SOC2 reports — we'll share SOC2 Type II and PCI if helpful.
[03:33] Anika: yes please. also, would Redwood accept a vendor security questionnaire for our risk team?
[03:37] Priya: yes we accept questionnaires; we'll also share our security pack. Priya to own that.
[03:43] Samir: networking - do you support VPC peering, private link, or only internet egress?
[03:48] Carlos: we support VPC peering for Private deployments, and AWS PrivateLink options for Dedicated. Hosted uses TLS egress; for PHI we typically recommend Private or Dedicated.
[03:58] Olivia: ok sounds good. on integrations - we have an existing EHR connection; we'll run Redwood as a middle service for summarization. any recommended arch?
[04:07] Carlos: yes - typical pattern: EHR -> ingestion service (de-id or redact if needed) -> Redwood API (sandbox first) -> summarizer service -> store. We'll share reference architecture and sample code. small chance our sample references KV cash instead of KV cache in one doc, sorry about typos.
[04:30] Anika: about pricing - we are evaluating Dedicated but want a pilot price first.
[04:34] Leah: we'll send an initial pilot pricing outline (Leah) and a Dedicated quote if you want reserved capacity. expect the pilot quote to be usage-based with discounts if you commit to Dedicated after pilot.
[04:48] Marcus: timeline again - if sandbox is next week, then pilot run mid-late October, production early December feasible?
[04:55] Priya: that's reasonable; compliance review mid-November is fine as long as we have the bench results by then.
[05:02] Samir: do you retain request payloads by default? we need control for retention and deletions.
[05:06] Carlos: retention is configurable; we can set short retention for sandbox. for production we support configurable retention policies and can auto-delete logs after X days — Priya we'll include options in the doc.
[05:18] Olivia: who will be our go-to for daily onboarding questions?
[05:21] Priya: Priya will be your CSM, and Carlos will be your technical SE during the pilot. Leah will coordinate pricing and contract.
[05:29] Leah: ok, let's capture clear next steps — Priya to send onboarding checklist and SSO doc; Carlos to spin up sandbox and run initial benchmark; Praxis to send sample de-id traffic and SAML metadata.
[05:45] Anika: quick question - do you support on-prem installs behind our firewall?
[05:49] Carlos: yes, we have a Private on-prem package for air-gapped or regulated setups, though that requires a longer lead time (we'll detail in doc).
[05:59] Marcus: any known blockers for PHI?
[06:02] Carlos: no blockers — it's about choosing the right deployment (Dedicated/Private) and KMS setup. we'll include a checklist for compliance.
[06:10] Olivia: can you also share sample evals so we can score model outputs?
[06:14] Priya: yes we'll share eval harness and example metrics for quality and regressions.
[06:19] Leah: timing for docs — we'll get SSO and security pack out by Monday, and sandbox by next Wednesday based on approvals.
[06:27] Anika: great. one last thing - escalation for incidents?
[06:30] Priya: we have an incident runbook and can set up an on-call rotation for your account on Dedicated; we'll include details in the onboarding packet.
[06:40] Leah: ok thanks everyone. recap and action items will be in the follow-up email.
[06:45] Olivia: thanks all.
[44:30] (call ends)
questions: Does Redwood support HSM-backed KMS for Dedicated/Private?
Can audit logs be exported to customer S3/ELK?
What's the expected time to provision a sandbox with SAML enabled?
notes: Transcript has occasional transcription errors (e.g., 'KV cash' vs 'KV cache', 'Redwood Dedicted' typo)
Praxis emphasized PHI and compliance as gating factors for production
